scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: This is the sign-in screen. Type the email address for your back-office account, then click Send Code.

scenes.label: enter-the-code
scenes.line: A four-digit code is sent to that address. Type it in. The screen moves on by itself.

scenes.label: dashboard
scenes.line: This is the dashboard. Questions are shared across every store, so they have their own card. Click Questions.

scenes.label: question-list
scenes.line: This lists every question you have. Click the plus button to add one.

scenes.label: new-question
scenes.line: Give the question a name, and choose its type. Select One gives the renter a short list to pick from.

scenes.label: question-details
scenes.line: Now the details. The inquiry is what the renter reads. The label is the short name on their form. Then add the options they can choose between.

scenes.label: back-to-questions
scenes.line: A new question starts as a draft, and a draft cannot be attached to anything. So we go back to Questions to switch it on.

scenes.label: find-the-question
scenes.line: Find the question you just made, and open it.

scenes.label: activate
scenes.line: Change the status to Active, then save. A requirement can use it now.

scenes.label: saved
scenes.line: That is the question ready to use.

scenes.label: sign-out
scenes.line: To finish, press Control K, type Logout, and press Enter.
